articles.title: Manufacturing growth hinges on ending NOCs
articles.summary: Redundant No Objection Certificates (NOCs) are significantly hindering India's medical device sector, undermining the 'Make in India' and 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' vision. These unnecessary regulatory hurdles risk derailing the sector's growth and its global ambitions, as outlined by the National Medical Device Policy. Streamlining these processes is crucial for fostering domestic manufacturing and achieving self-reliance in this critical industry.

articles.title: Ukraine says it struck Russian submarine in Black Sea using underwater drones [VIDEO]
articles.summary: Ukraine claimed to have successfully struck a Russian submarine in the Black Sea using underwater drones. This reported attack signifies an evolving aspect of naval warfare, demonstrating the increasing role of uncrewed autonomous vehicles in conflict zones. It highlights Ukraine's continued efforts to target Russia's naval assets and could impact the balance of power in the Black Sea region, underscoring advancements in military technology.

articles.title: Blue Jays cut ties with LHP to make room for Tyler Rogers signing
articles.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays, a major league baseball team, made a strategic roster adjustment. They released a left-handed pitcher (LHP) to accommodate the signing of Tyler Rogers. This move aims to bolster their pitching strength and optimize the lineup for the upcoming season. Such decisions are crucial for competitive performance in professional sports.

articles.title: Ukraine says it struck Russian submarine at a port with underwater drones
articles.summary: Ukraine's SBU successfully attacked a Russian submarine in Novorossiysk, a Black Sea port, claiming to have disabled it. This marks a significant first for Ukraine, utilizing its domestic security service to strike a naval target deep within Russian territory. Russia acknowledged the incident, highlighting the ongoing maritime dimension of the conflict and Ukraine's evolving asymmetric warfare capabilities.
